_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: near_eastern (egyptian) backbone + north_american (plains) substrate (cross-family blend, Egyptian-leaning)

blend.backbone: near_eastern (egyptian, Old/New Kingdom register: the per-aa god-king and nesut crown, the per-netjer temple-bureaucracy and hem-netjer priesthood, the itru river-cult and Nile-valley nomes, construct toponyms Per-/Niut-/Ta-, dj/tj/kh consonants, -aa/-et endings, VSO sentence-shape)
blend.overlay: north_american (plains, Comanche-leaning: the puuku horse-herds and kutsu bison of the open sonipi grassland and the high toya mountain, the akicita warrior-societies and paraibo chiefs raised by council, ejective consonants and glottal stops, polysynthetic descriptive compounds, the vision-quest puha and the medicine-cairn)
blend.lean: Egyptian-heavy - a Nile-valley temple-kingdom of the sun-disc and the river that spread out of its narrow green valley onto the great horse-and-bison plains and up to the high mountain: the per-aa and his temple-scribes rule and reckon the land from the river-cities, the horse-riding plains-clans furnish the war-host and herds and keep their own beast-and-grass tongue beneath the solar crown. The solar disc rides over the horse-and-eagle banner; the sun-temple of the river meets the great-plains sky.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_05 (Near-Eastern / Egyptian: Abydosian) x BASE_11 (North American / Plains: Numinan). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Egyptian base = Civilized, Plains base = Clanhold, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Denalikem is Civilized (feudal). Concept: an Egypto-Amerindian realm - the sun-temple of the river meeting the great-plains sky and the high mountain, the solar disc over the horse-and-eagle banner. Egyptian-LEAN: Egyptian phonology + temple/Nile register dominant (the per-aa god-king, the per-netjer temple, the itru river-cult, the nesut crown, construct toponyms); Plains substrate supplies the plain/beast/mountain/material words (the puuku horse, the kutsu bison, the toya mountain, the sonipi grass). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Egyptian register, with Plains substrate roots fused in (allowed, catalog 5.3); the kingdom-tier DISPLAY uses the approved foreign term 'Pharaoh'. DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon: Egyptian canon-morphs PRIMARY (abydosian sample_deity_renames), Plains canon-morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real Egyptian or Plains gods. Per the 2026-06-27 update: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. The fused single-word lexicon is derived via phonology.fusion_rules per gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md - no slash forms.

phonology.palette: Near-Eastern (Egyptian) backbone - dj/tj/kh, h, sh, q, l->r, v->w, long -aa and -et endings, triconsonantal stems, theophoric on the morphed canon-stems (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-, Riaret-, Numenaa-, Mery-) - meeting a Plains overlay: ejective consonants (k', t', p'), glottal stops, the barred-u vowel (written u), descriptive polysynthetic compounds. Per the CSV: ejective consonants with breathy vowels carried on Egyptian dj/tj/kh stops; grammar VSO with polysynthetic root-patterns (the Plains substrate's long descriptive compounds adapted onto Egyptian construct-chains and triconsonantal roots). The Plains beast/grass/mountain roots are filtered into the Egyptian inventory and take Egyptian endings; the Egyptian rule/river/temple register dominates.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC with Egyptian dj/tj/kh clusters and long -aa/-et; Plains glottal stops and ejectives retained as flavor; Plains polysynthetic compounds shortened and given Egyptian construct heads (Per-/Niut-/Ta-); VSO clause order; stress varies with an Egyptian penultimate pull.

sound_changes: Plains ejectives and glottal stops adapt to the Egyptian stop inventory: ejective k'/t'/p' -> Egyptian q/tj/dj, medial glottal-stop -> 0 or h; the barred-u u survives in substrate roots
Plains polysynthetic compounds collapse to a single triconsonantal-shaped root and take an Egyptian ending: final -bi/-pi/-pu/-tu -> -aa (masc/neutral) or -et (fem), long -aa preserved
Egyptian dj/tj/kh and l->r / v->w hold across all words; substrate roots are re-cut to fit the Egyptian CVC + dj/tj/kh shape
Egyptian VSO sentence-shape and construct-chain heads (Per-/Niut-/Ta-/Pa-) govern; very short substrate roots take an Egyptian -aa or -u
retain a few signature Plains phonemes (the barred-u, a kept glottal stop) and the Egyptian -aa/-et so both ancestries stay audible
fusion_rules.source_tilt: plain/beast/mountain/material/staple words from Plains (Comanche) roots (the horse-and-bison substrate works the grass and the high country: toya mountain, sonipi grass, puuku horse, kutsu bison, puhihwi metal); rule/kin/temple/Nile/land words from Egyptian roots (the prestige register reckons the river and the realm: itru river, per house, niut city, nesut crown, djeser sacred); every root then run through one Egyptian-shaped sound-law so the split is invisible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Egyptian river/rule/temple/land roots + Plains plain/beast/mountain/material/staple roots, all run through one Egyptian-shaped sound-law (dj/tj/kh, l->r/v->w, -aa/-et endings, VSO); portmanteaus mark the blended land and bloodline (the high country, the horse, the bison, the river-temple). No slash forms - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Egyptian temple-stock keep the filiation 'sa' (son of) and theophoric given names on the morphed god-stems; the Plains horse-clans keep the band/division name and an earned deed- or vision-name; the throne fuses both - a nesut who carries a theophoric Per- name and a deed-cognomen from the herds.
morphology.compounding_rule: Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god] house/temple of, Niut-[god] city of, Ta-[noun] land of, Pa-[noun] the-) layered over shortened Plains descriptive compounds ([quality|animal] + feature: Eka-toya red-mountain, Kutsiwa-sonisekh bison-grassland): the capital Denalikem (the great-mountain of the Black-Land), Per-Tjuraa (temple-city of the sun), Ta-Puukib (the land of the horse).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Egyptian temple-kingship over the Plains horse-clans: the per-aa god-king and his nesut-crown at the throne, the sepati-nomarchs over the river-nomes, the mer-mesha army-overseers leading the akicita horse-host; the hem-netjer priesthood and the per-netjer temple-scribes reckon and administer beneath, the paraibo clan-chiefs furnish the riders and herds)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Egyptian ladder, ascending, with the Plains horse-clan honors beneath. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general, leading the mounted akicita) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom - DISPLAYED with the approved foreign term 'Pharaoh'; Per-aa (the Great House) empire over the Per-aat. The Plains clans keep their paraibo (peace-chief) and tekwuniwap (war chief) and the akicita warrior-societies beneath the solar crown; the wab and hem-netjer priesthood and the puhakatu medicine-seers stand outside the ladder. Rank titles are the real Egyptian register with the Plains substrate honors (allowed); the kingdom DISPLAY 'Pharaoh' is an approved commonly-known foreign term.
title_ladder.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); Iry-pat (hereditary heir)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Egyptian temple-stock carry a theophoric given name + filiation (sa-X) and/or earned epithet; the Plains horse-clans carry an earned deed/vision-name + band/division; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Egyptian temple-and-court stock keep theophoric names (X-hotep, Mery-X, Sa-X) on the morphed canon-stems; the Plains horse-clans keep earned deed- and vision-names (Iron Shirt, Spotted Eagle) and band-names; the throne fuses both - a god-king with a Per- temple-name and a herds-deed cognomen.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Egyptian devotional on the morphed canon-stems: X-hotep (X-is-content), X-mose (X-is-born), Mery-X (beloved-of-X), Sa-X (son-of-X), e.g. Tjuraa-hotep, Mery-Djeroraa; the Plains clans rarely name the powers directly, more often a vision-sign (animal, sky, weather) under a power, e.g. a war-vision under Maraksa.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Egyptian canon-morphs PRIMARY (abydosian sample_deity_renames, via Egyptian phonology: l->r, v->w, -us/-a -> -aa/-et, dj/tj/kh flavor), Plains canon-morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real Egyptian or Plains gods. Same shared pantheon, two name-sets for the two ancestries. Alignment any of Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per the 2026-06-27 update); the realm's stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The solar disc of the river-temple rides over the horse-and-eagle banner of the plains; the powers are met both in the built per-netjer of the river-cities and at the open-sky medicine-cairn of the herds.
religion.the_one: Atjernaa (Egyptian; Plains Ateruna) - the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

Raptis.gloss: the red hunter of the herds

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atjernaa, Tjuraa the just sun, Oranetj of the sworn war, Riaret the merciful, Gayandaa the enduring earth - through the river-temple's offerings and the law of right-order (maat); names the Chaotic powers the -kin of the great serpent Hefau, warded; the solar disc and the medicine-cairn bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings of the river-cities, and the ancestral chiefs and animal-spirits of the plains; the great powers invoked at the per-netjer and the open-sky medicine-cairn situationally, all somewhat honored and somewhat feared
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Marakhu the city-burner, Maraksa the war-fire, the storm and the greed-serpent), and names the Lawful powers - and Atjernaa - as the cold sun-tyrants and chain-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the -kin of the great serpent Hefau (Egyptian) or under dread Plains epithets, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhu the City-Burner (Plains Maraksa the war-fire, the raider); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devouring Hefau (Plains Vachita the void); Dementus -> Tamawi the storm-thunder; Lusanto -> Lusanta the Hoard-Worm.

clergy_ladder.7: Hem-netjer Tepy (first prophet/high priest) / Numunu-puhakatu (the band's high seer)
clergy_ladder.9: Hem-netjer Aa (great prophet) / Naika-puhakatu (the council's great seer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) of [power] in the river-cities, and the open-sky medicine-cairn of [power] on the high plain: 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa', 'the Medicine-Cairn of Maraksa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings of the river, 'the justified [name]' (maa-kheru), venerated at tomb-temples; and the great chiefs and vision-seers of the plains who became sky- and animal-spirits, honored at the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: the sun-disc above the feather of right-order, over the horse-and-eagle banner
holy_symbol_motifs.Oranetj: an iron spear crossed with the war-lance of the herds
holy_symbol_motifs.Rapetj: the red hunter's bow beneath the open plains sky

banks_patterns.ships: solar-barques of the river and the great war-lances and herds of the plain: 'Barque of Tjuraa', 'Beloved of the River', 'the Red Lance', 'Cloud-Eater (a famed horse)'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [god] Division and the mounted warrior-societies: 'the Division of Rapetj', 'the Horse-Akicita of Denalikem', 'the Sun-Disc Companies', 'the Dog-Soldiers'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Lotus', 'The Red Crown Cup', 'The Bison and Sun-Disc'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: tombs and pyramids of the god-kings and old burial-scaffolds and spirit-haunted buttes of the plains: 'the Tomb of Per-aa [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer', 'the Medicine-Cairn of [chief]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'

flagship_settlements: Denalikem (the chief seat - the great-mountain of the Black-Land)
